conditional.title: South Sudan visitor-visa route depends on an unpublished nationality partition
conditional.summary: South Sudan's current government guidance says most travellers can obtain a visa on arrival, while some nationalities require pre-approval; the linked Interior service supplies a pre-travel eVisa workflow but neither source publishes which ordinary passports use which route.
conditions: The Government Trade Information Hub says most travellers can obtain a visa on arrival, but some nationalities require a pre-approved visa or additional entry requirements.
The Hub links the Ministry of Interior eVisa service, which provides online application and a downloadable visa before travel.
Neither live source publishes the ordinary-passport nationality partition between the arrival and pre-approved routes.
The route therefore cannot be reduced to one passport-wide rank status; this characterization does not change imported scores, ranks or sitemap eligibility.
